entries.summary: Preparation stage complete for app-shell-window-layout.
Plan complete: 12 AC / 12 FR / 3 NFR / 5 SC, 14-row traceability matrix, survey including the Q1/Q2/Q3 contrast-policy gate answers.
Backlog complete: 13 tasks across 4 execution waves.
Wired kotlin-test into commonTest for LibraryConventionPlugin and FeatureConventionPlugin -- the first test infrastructure anywhere in this repo (previously zero test files existed).

WCAG contrast sweep (WcagContrast.kt sRGB relative-luminance implementation + PaletteContrastTest, 54 pairings per palette at ship time) over both shipped palettes, per the gate's Q1/Q2/Q3 policy answers. Zero edits to presentation-core-styling/src/commonMain -- mechanical proof tokens were adopted unmodified (AC-36).
Shell pure logic and state: ShellTab, shortcutToTab, ShellWindowDefaults, clampPanelWidth, ShellState, each with a dedicated unit-test suite (26 tests total).
PanelResizeHandle atom (onDelta/onDragStarted/onDragStopped, no internal clamping or persistence) and StageSurface (dotted bezel-less stage region, dot grid drawn once per visible area).
ShellToolbar (six fixed named slots) and ShellStatusBar organisms, assembled entirely from shipped kit components -- no new leaf component authored.
SidePanelFrame reusing the existing SidebarTabs molecule with exactly three tabs (Notes/Payload/History).

RectifyWindowShell composes the full slot contract (toolbar/stage/statusBar required, sidePanel nullable); when sidePanel is null neither PanelResizeHandle nor SidePanelFrame composes (a genuine compositional branch, not a visibility modifier). Four previews (no-panel/with-panel x Light/Dark).

pref_side_panel_width wired through the full preference chain (new key; pref_theme untouched): PreferenceSource/Impl, Mapper, ConfigureRepository, Get/SetSidePanelWidthUseCase, both appended at the end of their respective layer groups.

Flipped the effective theme default from Light to System: ThemeModel.MaterialU renamed to System (stored value "materialu" preserved for backward compatibility), App.kt null-branch and initial state both resolve to ThemeMode.System.

RectifyWindow: 1240x820 initial / 1024x700 minimum window geometry via rememberWindowState + AWT minimumSize, macOS-only traffic-light chrome behind an os.name guard, Cmd+1/2/3 key handling, theme and side-panel-width wiring. runDesktopApp() now renders RectifyWindow (desktop-application/Main.kt unchanged).
Filled every toolbar/status-bar slot with static stubs matching design comp 02, and added the status-bar theme-override control (System -> Light -> Dark cycle, persists across relaunch).
Inspection evidence pass: four in-process Compose render PNGs (light/dark x no-panel/with-panel) plus supporting evidence captured later in the cycle.
Verified the PRD green-signal hue-150 reconciliation as a no-op: '152' absent from PRD docs and prd-handoff.json; no plan/preparation file or Kotlin source modified.

Fixed three commonTest backtick function names containing a comma/apostrophe, illegal on Kotlin/Native. Desktop had compiled fine so every per-task gate was honest but incomplete; compileTestKotlinIosArm64/IosSimulatorArm64 was failing and breaking ./gradlew build repo-wide. This was caught by Stage 5's full-build regression check, not by any per-task gate.

Cleared three audit-found defects approved at the gate: rewrote .claude/rules/testing.md (it falsely claimed zero tests exist and prescribed T-1's already-finished work as future work -- this file auto-loads into every agent's context); fixed domain-core/README.md:21's stale ThemeModel(..., MaterialU) reference (last MaterialU string outside .pipeline); added the four PaletteContrastTest pairings its own guard test had silently omitted (onPrimary over primaryHover/primaryPress, both palettes -- both named by AC-36), raising the guard count 54 -> 56.

Fixed the disabled 'Resolve & Send' AppButton, which used Theme.color.chrome as its disabled fill -- the same colour as the toolbar it sits on, rendering it invisible. Switched to Theme.color.seg; seg over chrome composites to (223,223,221), an exact match for the measured design value.

Fixed the macOS traffic-light leading inset, measured 21dp short of the design: the build reserved 78dp with a 13dp gap after the green light, the design puts the first toolbar control at 102dp with a 34dp gap. Corrected 78dp -> 99dp; the pre-existing ShellWindowDefaultsTest pinned the old value and was updated with the measurement rationale. Re-verified in the real running app: gap now exactly 34pt.

Added the A/B toolbar-vs-design comparison screenshot and the operator's real running-app screenshot, closing the two remaining human-gate inspection items (AC-34 window-chrome placement and theme rendering) with direct visual evidence rather than the in-process renders alone.
Execution stage complete: all 13 tasks done, 44 tests across 9 suites (the first test suite of any kind in this repo), full cross-target build green.

data.summary: app-shell-window-layout replaces the template's single-pane desktop entry point with RectifyWindowShell: a toolbar/stage/status-bar/side-panel slot contract, System-default theming with persistence, Cmd+1/2/3 tab-mapping, a clamped resizable side panel with persisted width, and macOS-only traffic-light chrome -- backed by the repo's first-ever test suite (44 tests, 9 suites, introduced from zero by T-1). Stage 5 found and fixed one repo-wide regression (illegal Kotlin/Native test names breaking the full build), two visual defects found only by human inspection against the design comp (an invisible disabled button, a 21dp-short macOS chrome inset), one audit-found contrast-sweep gap (two untested token pairings), and two stale docs (an auto-loading rule file and a module README) that this spec's own changes had made false. Seven items are explicit human waivers -- most notably ratifying a change to a previously sealed Q1-A survey answer on hairline contrast, which is a deviation from a human decision rather than merely from a dispatch brief.
